name: Desert Motel
source:
It's late at night, you are working on a motel and suddenly two handsome men appear to check in. Which one would you choose to help first? The chubby charismatic guy or the serious mature boss?

[From [url=https://sr-curly-cat.itch.io/desert-motel]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
深夜，你在一家汽车旅馆工作，突然出现两个帅哥入住，你会选择先帮助哪一个呢？胖乎乎的有魅力的家伙还是严肃成熟的老板？

[来自[url=https://sr-curly-cat.itch.io/desert-motel]Itch.io[/url]]
